subject: gk
question: Which of the following is not an essential Qualification for the candidature of President?

options.text: Qualified for election as a member of the House of the People

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** option "4) Higher Education"** is not an essential qualification for the candidature of the **President of India.**
 
• **The President of India** need not have a** higher education degree.**
 
• **The Constitution of India **does not list educational qualifications as a requirement.
 
• **The essential qualifications, as per the Constitution of India,** are:
 
 
• The candidate must be a cit
